transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. [Name]. Um, thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm not wasting your time, honestly. It's just... well, mostly I'm here because I've been feeling pretty tired lately. Not like, regular tired, I guess? It's like I can sleep, but it doesn't really fix it. Even just doing little things around the house, like unloading the dishwasher, or trying to read for this certificate class I'm taking... it just feels like a lot right now. Is that... does that make sense? I know it probably just sounds like I'm being lazy, but it feels different than that.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Um... yeah, I guess maybe a little bit? I really don't want to sound like I'm just complaining, because I know I shouldn't be, but... yeah. 

It's just that I've kind of stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself? Like, normally I love sketching, or going to gallery openings... I usually do yoga and cook a lot, too. Or even just playing tennis with my friend. But lately, I just... I don't know, I haven't wanted to do any of it. I feel a little guilty admitting that, honestly, because I know I should be keeping up with my hobbies and seeing people. 

Does that... is that the kind of thing you mean?
How long have you been feeling this way—weeks, or has it been going on for months or longer?

Um, I think it's been... maybe around three months? Give or take? I really hope I'm not making it sound worse than it is, because I know people go through phases where they're just a little more tired or quiet, right? 

But yeah, this stretch where everything feels so heavy and I just don't have the energy or interest to do much... it's been about three months. I probably should have tried to push through it better, honestly. I'm sorry if that's a long time to wait before coming in... is three months a normal amount of time for something like this?
Can you tell me more about your sleep itself—are you having trouble falling asleep or staying asleep, or are you sleeping more hours than you used to?

Um, my sleep... I mean, I think it's mostly okay? I don't want to make it sound like a huge problem, because I know everyone struggles with sleep sometimes. 

I guess I might be sleeping a little bit more than usual? Like, I'll sleep through the night, but then it's just really hard to get out of bed in the morning. And sometimes I end up taking a nap in the afternoon, which I know I probably shouldn't do. I really try to keep a normal schedule, but I just feel so drained. 

I'm not like, tossing and turning all night or anything, though. So that's good, right? Is it okay that I'm sleeping a little extra, or does that mean I'm doing something wrong?
Have you noticed any unintentional weight changes, or feeling unusually cold or your skin becoming dry, over these past few months?

Um... weight changes? Well, I haven't really noticed feeling cold or having dry skin, so I think I'm okay there. 

As for my weight, I mean... I really don't want it to sound like I'm doing it on purpose or anything, because I know it's important to eat right. But I guess my appetite has just been a little... off? Sometimes it gets to the end of the day and I realize I've only really had coffee and maybe a few bites of something. I really should be better about making actual meals. 

I did notice my jeans are fitting a little looser lately, even though I haven't been trying to lose weight at all. I hope that's not a bad thing? I just... I haven't felt very hungry, I guess. Is that something I should be worried about?
Have you noticed feeling short of breath, dizzy, or your heart racing with activity, or any unusually heavy menstrual periods recently?

Um, no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed any of that. My breathing and my heart seem fine, I think? I try not to overdo it, so I haven't felt dizzy or anything like that. 

And my periods have been pretty normal, I guess. Just the usual. I mean, I hope I would notice if something was really wrong with my heart or my breathing, right? I'm pretty sure everything is okay in that department. Is it normal that I'm not having those issues? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, like becoming more constipated than usual, over the past few months?

Um, no, I haven't really noticed anything like that. My stomach has been totally fine, I think. I haven't been constipated at all. 

I mean, I try to make sure I drink enough water even when my appetite is off, so maybe that helps? Everything seems pretty regular. I hope it's okay that I don't have all these other symptoms you're asking about... I just want to make sure I'm being helpful and giving you the right answers. But yeah, no problems in that area, thankfully. That's a good thing, right?
